'''Aden''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
He was ambitious, and believed that he was on the rise in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], but he was posted to [[Vanishing Place]], a secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], to keep him out of the way. This was possibly a result of his violent temper, which had resulted in him being transferred out of a number of units by their commanders, because he would demonstrate his loyalty to the Empire by berating fellow officers for even minor offences. He served on Felucia as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vischera]]'s second-in-command when an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team [[Mission to Felucia (Imperial Period)|attacked]] the facility.
